d: Thierry Henry is one of football's greats, but a light-hearted exchange with Lamine Yamal at the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony became an unexpected talking point. After Yamal won his third consecutive Kopa Trophy, Henry asked whether it was the award he really wanted, prompting a backlash from some Barcelona fans online. Henry later clarified that he was not trying to check Yamal's ego. So why did a moment of banter turn into a controversy? Rupha Ramani examines Thierry Henry, Lamine Yamal and the changing culture of football fandom, where social media can turn even a passing joke into a much…
